prompts.map: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE beautiful 2D overworld map background for a personal Dragon Ball browser RPG, wide 3:2 landscape canvas. A polished Nintendo DS / 16-bit RPG illustration, authentic original Dragon Ball landscape with anime pixel art, very clear shapes, vivid turquoise water, emerald grass, ochre sandy paths, capsule-like architecture and rounded craggy mountains. Bird's eye view angled slightly to show building facades, NEVER a side scrolling scene. Complete cohesive small island continent surrounded by turquoise ocean on left/lower sides, with a winding connected sandy footpath network and a wide central crossroads at x50% y57%. EXACT landmarks with generous empty path area at their entrances for HTML buttons and tiny avatars: at x24% y30%, Master Roshi training grounds, dirt exercise yard, wooden punching posts and milk crates; at x17% y65%, unmistakable small pink Kame House with red roof on a little beach peninsula connected by a walkable sandy coast path, NO text on house; at x51% y20%, entrance arch to dense lush forest with rocky mountains behind it, exploration route; at x81% y48%, recognizable Tenkaichi Budokai martial arts tournament courtyard, tiled square fighting ring and traditional red-roof pavilion, no text; at x66% y69%, charming village technique marketplace, orange-blue awning stalls, scrolls and small capsule-shaped shops; at x39% y74%, small blue domed storage capsule hut with stacked chests for inventory. Open central crossroads and training paths link ALL SIX landmarks without barriers or dead ends. Distant upper right: Red Ribbon style small military fortress without logo/letters, canyon and desert scenery; upper left: steep rocky Dragon Ball hills, tiny waterfalls, palm trees. Use comfortably wide walkable land connecting Kame House to main island. Leave bottom 12% mostly beautiful shoreline, no landmarks near edges. Clean terrain, correct consistent perspective, no floating roofs, no roads through walls or deep water, no impossible stairs, no cropped structures. No people, no characters, NO lettering, NO words, NO labels, NO banners/UI, NO icons, no border, no watermark. This must be a real usable game map, not a menu mockup. Warm sunlight, rich painterly pixel details, clear separation of landmarks and paths, beautiful readable compact game art.
prompts.sprites: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent pixel art WALKING SPRITE ATLAS for a personal Dragon Ball RPG world map. Strict 4 columns × 5 rows evenly spaced grid, one full-body sprite per cell, same camera, scale and feet baseline in all cells. Canvas 4:5 portrait. Exactly FIVE different characters, one race per row, FOUR animation frames across each row in left-to-right order: left-leg forward, neutral passing, right-leg forward, neutral passing opposite. All walk facing screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view, gently swinging arms, natural legs, feet point correct direction, proper anatomy, zero attack poses. Each sprite tiny charming chibi original 16-bit Nintendo DS game character with thick dark outline, limited crisp pixel shading, readable silhouette, consistent light from above-left. ROW1: Saiyajin, Goku black spiky hair, orange gi, blue belt and blue boots, no Super Saiyan. ROW2: Humano, bald Krillin with six forehead dots, orange gi blue belt, shorter than Goku. ROW3: Namekuseijin, Piccolo green skin two antennae, purple outfit blue sash, no cape and no turban so compact silhouette. ROW4: Majin, chubby pink Majin Buu head antenna, purple cape, black yellow vest, baggy white trousers and yellow boots, smiling recognizable face. ROW5: Freeza race, canonical first-form Frieza, purple domed head, white horns pointed out, pink-purple skin white chest armor, visible curved slim tail, keep tail in own cell. All limbs, heads, horns, tails and feet COMPLETELY INSIDE their own cell with at least 15% transparent margin; no overlap, no neighboring fragment. Every character retains EXACTLY same design and height across its four walking frames. Four frames MUST actually change walking legs and arms, not identical copies. Flat TRUE alpha transparent background across entire sheet, no ground, no floor, no shadows, no checkerboard painted behind characters, no environment, no text, no labels, no frames, no watermark. Clean usable game sprites, anatomically correct two arms and two legs for each.

Exactly FOUR equal cells in ONE row, one COMPLETE small chibi Buu in every cell. Canvas 3:1 landscape. Each full-body figure occupies at most 60% cell WIDTH and 75% cell HEIGHT. IMPORTANT: leave VERY LARGE fully transparent padding around every figure: at least20% cell width BOTH SIDES.
